purpose: Trace origin, attribution, license and approval of lexical assets before redistributing offline packs.
notices: Catalog metadata does not certify content availability or permissions.
Record each downloaded dump URL, retrieval date, exact source edition/revision, license terms, modifications, review decision, pack hash and required attribution before distribution.
Wiktionary text is generally CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL; individual media or imported material may carry separate terms. Review each incorporated item.
A compiled offline pack can inherit share-alike obligations. Do not treat third-party records as proprietary solely because bundled into an app.
